name: WhatsApp Business
verdict: Build as a Meta Tech Provider with Embedded Signup: business verification first, then App Review for Advanced access on two permissions with a screencast each. Onboarding is capped at 10 new customers a week at first.
needGuide: Yes — follow the Tech Provider path: business verification, then App Review with screencasts for both permissions.

auth.detail: Meta Embedded Signup (Facebook Login for Business): customer completes a popup, your server exchanges the code (30-second TTL) via GET /oauth/access_token for a customer-scoped business token. Tech Providers use business tokens exclusively. Token lifetime not stated in the pages read.

effort.timeToProduction: 1-3 weeks (business verification plus App Review, which averages about 24 hours per Meta)

approval.gate: Tech Provider path: verify your business (required before App Review), submit App Review for Advanced access to whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging (separate screencast per permission, privacy policy, app icon). Without Advanced access you cannot onboard customers. Onboarding is capped at 10 new customers per rolling 7 days until the limit is raised to 200; above that you must become a Meta Business Partner.

scopes.why: Both whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging need Advanced Access through App Review.
scopes.summary: whatsapp_business_management (account settings, templates) and whatsapp_business_messaging (phone numbers, send/receive) both need Advanced access via App Review; whatsapp_business_manage_events only for Marketing Messages with Conversions API. Requesting unneeded permissions causes rejection.

cost: Free to build; customers add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager and Meta bills them (Tech Providers have no credit line)
prerequisites: Account and owner: Admin on the Meta app and a business portfolio admin to complete Business Verification; use a company-owned business portfolio.

Where you register: Meta App Dashboard → Create app (Business type, WhatsApp use case) → Use cases → Customize → Tech Provider onboarding → Start verification → App Review; Embedded Signup Builder under WhatsApp
Cost: Free to build; customers add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager and Meta bills them (Tech Providers have no credit line)

registerAt.path: Meta App Dashboard → Create app (Business type, WhatsApp use case) → Use cases → Customize → Tech Provider onboarding → Start verification → App Review; Embedded Signup Builder under WhatsApp

steps.do: Create a Meta Business-type app with the WhatsApp use case and a business portfolio
Complete Business Verification (name, address, phone, website, documents)
Set app icon, privacy policy URL and category; record two screencasts (send message; create template)
Submit App Review for Advanced access to both WhatsApp permissions with written explanations
Implement Embedded Signup v5 (v4 min): Facebook Login for Business configuration, FB.login with config_id, response_type code
Exchange the code server-side within 30 s, call POST /<WABA_ID>/subscribed_apps, register the phone number with a 6-digit PIN
Subscribe to the account_update webhook and have the customer add a payment method

roles.team: Admin on the Meta app and a business portfolio admin to complete Business Verification; use a company-owned business portfolio.
roles.console: App Dashboard → App roles → Roles → Add People (Admin, Developer, Tester); in development mode only these roles see unapproved permissions.
roles.customer: Customer signs in with Facebook/Meta Business credentials and completes Embedded Signup (likely needs admin on their business portfolio; docs do not state the role), then adds a payment method; business verification gives them higher limits.

testing: In development mode, test with users holding Admin/Developer/Tester roles; business apps get Standard Access automatically.
Test Embedded Signup with your own credentials on an HTTPS domain added to Allowed domains.
Sandbox accounts are being deleted gradually.

blockers.problem: Embedded Signup v2/v3 were deprecated Oct 15, 2026 and are now served as v4; v5 was released Oct 20, 2026

blockers.fix: Click submit; one video per permission, no screenshots.

blockers.problem: Accounts created via the developer app cannot be onboarded through Embedded Signup

automation.agentCan: Write Embedded Signup front and back end, webhook handling, template calls, and draft App Review explanations and shot lists.
automation.humanMust: Business verification with documents, Meta login and 2FA, recording and submitting screencasts, customer payment method, possible Meta Business Partner agreement above 200 customers.

uncertain: The brief says Meta retired Access Verification around Oct 9, 2026.

The Embedded Signup overview I fetched still listed Access Verification as a requirement for the 10-to-200 limit increase, while the Tech Provider and version pages never mention it: likely retired or folded into Business Verification, but unconfirmed.
Business verification wait time not stated.
